errors.evidence: The green line representing "start" is described as having no markers, but the plot shows it has circular markers.
The orange line representing "random" is described as having a dashed line style, but the plot shows it is a solid line.
In the description of the green line, the value at "bb" is stated as about 0.7, but the plot shows this value is clearly below 0.5 (approximately 0.49).
In the description of the purple line, the peak at "Estadio" is stated as being 'near 0.9', but the plot shows this value is much higher, at approximately 0.97.
